description: Source code for E2SM control action executor related to DU (Distributed Unit) configuration, including classes and functions for handling RRM policy ratio control requests and responses.

classes.name: e2sm_ccc_control_action_du_executor_base
classes.description: Base class for executing control actions related to DU configuration, providing common methods and properties.

classes.name: e2sm_ccc_control_o_rrm_policy_ratio_executor
classes.description: Derived class implementing specific control action for O-RRM Policy Ratio, supporting RIC control requests.

methods.name: get_action_id
methods.description: Returns the action ID associated with the control executor.

methods.name: get_action_name
methods.description: Returns the name of the control action structure.

methods.name: get_control_action_definition
methods.description: Returns the control action definition (currently a placeholder).

methods.name: ric_control_action_supported
methods.description: Checks if the control request is supported based on RIC style type and control message structure.

methods.name: execute_ric_control_action
methods.description: Executes the control action asynchronously, performing DU configuration and generating a response.
